desc: Prove the connected-component characterization and show that every connected component of the disjoint-interval graph has constant diameter, including endpoint-touching and nested intervals.
Derive an exact efficient data structure for minimum-weight two-edge paths.
Derive an exact efficient data structure for minimum-weight three-edge paths, including the mutual disjointness constraint between the two intermediate vertices.
Combine direct, two-edge, and three-edge candidates with endpoint weights and component checks.
Produce a correctness proof for the full shortest-path reduction.
Develop and validate an \(O((N+Q)\operatorname{polylog}N)\) Python implementation with fast I/O and coordinate handling.
